attestation: I read AGENTS.md §1 for orientation and used the permitted briefs, C82 captures, walk rig, and my own running app. I saw five existing filenames in my own walk directory from an interrupted L3 run, preserved them, and did not use them as evidence. I did not read prohibited materials or save a friction note. I reviewed two sampled regions at native resolution from each of the 194 first screens, 492 scroll frames, and 20 runtime captures. I opened selected frames in full and checked the accessibility trees and layout data for the findings. I stopped the walk daemon and verified that ports 4326 and 5326 were released. I used no browser in the follow-up pass.
